mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_usage ( session_id, message_id, user_id, source_scene, provider_name, model_code, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, usage_source, create_time ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{sourceScene}, #{providerName}, #{modelCode}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{usageSource}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) FROM ai_agent_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND create_time < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month')
